exposure: First trimester exposure to angiotensin AT1 receptor blockers (ARBs)
cohort: The study included 215 prospectively ascertained pregnancies with first trimester exposure to ARBs and 642 non-hypertensive pregnancies for comparison.
finding: The study supports that ARBs are not major teratogens, though higher rates of prematurity and reduced birth weight were observed in the ARB cohort compared to the non-hypertensive group.
